main_body: bare gothic tree with branches and crows
evidence: The tree is drawn as a flat front silhouette/cutout: the branches at row 0 are clipped straight across by the top edge of the canvas, the base at rows 60-62 is a flat horizontal bar rather than spreading 3/4 roots, and the trunk/branches are simple 2D ribbons with side-to-side cylinder shading and no 3/4 canopy volume or top surfaces.

style.evidence: Compared to the Beodeul reference trees (which have rich multi-step bark grain, spreading roots with grass tufts, and dense volumetric branching), the candidate has simplistic ribbon-like branches clipped at the canvas top, a flat bar base, and much lower tile density.
